note: Concrete rules of the three-layer scene generator mapped to existing code/fields or to a missing input. kind: required = spatial/semantic condition that must hold; parameter = configurable per-scene value (no planning standard is asserted). status: implemented | partial | bypassed | absent.

layers.1_normal_environment: buildable regions -> ordinary buildings (type mix, density, real footprints, access/circulation), stations, roads; pre-disaster, no damage.
layers.2_disaster: core G02-G06 applied to layer-1 world: occupancy, hazard footprint/intensity, damage grade per building, debris from damaged sources onto reachable roads, casualty states.
layers.3_rescue: deployment (staging, command post, agent mix), public brief, task generation/allocation/execution/events from resulting state.

A_source_regions_coordinates.rule: Plots/buildable regions = METADATA_RESERVATION polygons from <SID>_aas_full_yup.glb extras (kind filter per scene)
Roads/accesses = same-source route-A layout JSON centerlines/widths/access polygons; split into junction segments as core road entities
A_source_regions_coordinates.missing_input: route-A layout JSON exists only for SC01/SC03/SC04/GT04; other 9 scenes need their road centerlines from their scene spec/build (blk_build spec 'centerlines') - to be exported per scene, not hand-copied

A_source_regions_coordinates.rule: Surface class per footprint sample from canonical grid (ROAD_CARRIAGEWAY, SIDEWALK, PLOT_SURFACE, ...)
ENU<->core XY and render height from canonical grid

B_asset_semantics_state_eligibility.rule: Each placeable asset has entity type, footprint (L,W,H), forward axis, states (D0-D3 / intact/blocking/opening), from measured GLB
Building prototype attributes for core: building.use, building.structure (core fragility enum timber/masonry/RC/steel/mixed), building.floors, from Excel 建筑36态 (形制, 固定材料体系, H)
B_asset_semantics_state_eligibility.missing_input: prototype->use/structure mapping table read from Excel rows (not invented)

B_asset_semantics_state_eligibility.rule: Damage display variant = prototype x core truth building.visual_damage (none/minor/major/destroyed -> D0..D3)
Scene eligibility of an asset (disaster family, region kind, condition) comes from Excel applicability + scene profile, assigned in configs/asset_allocation.json

C_normal_environment_density_mix.rule: Building count per region derived from density target and real footprints: place until target coverage reached or no legal position remains (report shortfall)
C_normal_environment_density_mix.where: layout.py places a fixed list of 2 configured buildings

C_normal_environment_density_mix.rule: Density target per region kind (e.g. building footprint coverage ratio range)
Type mix weights over eligible prototypes per region kind
building.capacity from prototype floor area x floors x persons-per-area parameter (core G02 then draws occupants with occupancy_prior.by_use)
C_normal_environment_density_mix.where: core G02 uses building.capacity; currently max(2,len(occupants))

D_placement_access_overlap.rule: Full rotated footprint (interior sampled) on allowed classes; buildings/stations not on carriageway/sidewalk
Pairwise footprint gap >= clearance; damaged-state envelope reserved
Plot access corridor kept clear; each building entrance faces an access/internal circulation path that connects to the access
D_placement_access_overlap.where: approach corridor per placed building; with many buildings an internal circulation strip network per plot is needed
D_placement_access_overlap.missing_input: entrance side per prototype (Excel 固定平面与入口)

D_placement_access_overlap.rule: Agents spawn off carriageway on walkable classes, vehicle may stage on a carriageway lane
No legal space -> explicit ValueError naming entity/rule

E_disaster_cause_effect.where: core truth G03: footprint = central 60% map box for earthquake
E_disaster_cause_effect.missing_input: optional scene epicentre/footprint parameter; otherwise core default stays

E_disaster_cause_effect.rule: Damage grade = exposure x fragility(structure) x noise (G04)
Debris only from damaged source within reach onto nearest road, blocks that road entity (G05, obstacle_rate)
E_disaster_cause_effect.where: core G05; disabled via no_debris_from, replaced by authored obstacles slot

E_disaster_cause_effect.rule: Debris display pose/yaw/footprint = G05 point on road + road direction; footprint within carriageway
E_disaster_cause_effect.where: engine initial_yaw from layout only covers generator-placed debris

F_people_agent_deployment.rule: Occupants from capacity x occupancy prior (G02), outdoor count prior
Casualty mobility/injury/needs from structural grade (G06); interior people stay in their building
Agent mix per scenario (profile agent_mix: coordinator 1, uav 2, robot_dog 2, ground_vehicle 1, specialist_team 1, compute_node 1)
F_people_agent_deployment.where: configs/SC01.json lists 5 agents; profile mix not used

F_people_agent_deployment.rule: Staging at a road-network boundary entry; command post + teams near staging off carriageway
Vehicle public deployment goal = an access reachable on its public map (no hidden casualty location)
F_people_agent_deployment.where: navigation_goals target = access of authored building-1 (uses authored knowledge of the casualty building)

G_task_event_state_consistency.rule: Tasks generated only from agent beliefs/observations (core taskgen), allocation by capability, no hidden truth
Road block/clear/pass, person found/contact/extricate/load/transport/handover as distinct evidenced states
Treatment T031 via existing A019 with station medical_pack stock
G_task_event_state_consistency.where: T031 now in coordinator/team allowlist; success depends on co-location at receiving point

G_task_event_state_consistency.rule: Displayed state = world truth state (damage variant, debris present/opening/cleared, person carried)
G_task_event_state_consistency.where: engine._publish; building damage variant still from authored grade (B3)

H_cross_scene_asset_coverage_gaps.rule: Every Excel-listed delivered asset is placed in >=1 generated scene instance and appears in run records
H_cross_scene_asset_coverage_gaps.where: lane S2 inventory/allocation, then per-scene placement rules

H_cross_scene_asset_coverage_gaps.rule: Coverage measured from generated layouts/run initial_truth (asset_id per entity), not from allocation lists
Gap report to user (missing/plan-only/corrupt/not integrable; scene/task need; suggested state/size/interaction); formal Excel untouched
